body:
Ive done Isopropylphenidate (IPPH from here on out) a few times before but I feel as though Ive got all I can get out of the substance so I figured Id go ahead and write up a report.
Quick history: Been doing drugs for about 3 years now. Well versed in most stimulants and a wide variety of other substances from dissociatives to deliriants. Im not taking any medications. I do have a daily stack of Vitamin C, ALCAR, ALA, and noopept that I take for cognitive function and just general health benefits. These also help with comedowns which Ill get into later.
Put simply, IPPH is what I would call the perfect functional stimulant. Theres little recreational potential even at doses up to 100mg, so Id simply look elsewhere if youre looking for euphoria. That said, if you need to get schoolwork or housework done then look no further. The lack of side effects and the barely-there comedown make IPPH a very forgiving substance. Anyways, onto the report.
T+0:00  Intranasally administer 30mg of IPPH. I ate a small meal about 45 minutes ago but I doubt it will affect the experience at all. There is a very slight burn, but nothing even a novice couldnt handle. If Adderall is a 2/10 on the pain scale, then IPPH is around a 3/10. Pain subsides after about 15 seconds. There is also a drip, but it isnt anything repulsive. Its not like the sweet drip of Adderall, but it doesnt make me want to gag or anything either. Ever so slightly bitter, but easy enough to handle.
T+0:10  First alerts. Im much more motivated to do things that need to be done.
T+0:10  First alerts. Im much more motivated to do things that need to be done.
Plus, once I get started on something, I find it impossible to put down until it is finished. I wouldnt say Im having fun like one would on an amphetamine, but the laser focus drives me to finish whatever Im working on.
T+0:30 - Same as above, but the effects have intensified. Im constantly looking for something to work on. I am getting ever-so-slight tinges of euphoria which are nice, but theyre few and far between. Only side effects Im experiencing at this point are some slight jaw tension, a very slightly increased heartrate (my resting is around 65BPM, Im now sitting at around 90BPM), and dry mouth. I grab a powerade and take 200mg of chelated magnesium.
T+1:00  Ive reached the plateau of the high, if you want to call it that. My jaw tension has lessened thanks to the magnesium. Ive finished what work needed to be done, so I go ahead and fire up Overwatch. As is typical with stimulants, my gameplay is overall much better. My aim is more on point, my reaction speed is better, and Im able to keep track of many things at once such as enemy ultimate ability status and how healthy my team is.
T+2:00  Nothing new to report. Same as where I was an hour ago. Maybe starting to feel a slight comedown, but I could just be wore out from playing video games. I managed to eat a turkey sandwich with relative ease. Definitely easier than eating on amphetamine. It still isnt pleasant, but its much less of a chore.
T+3:00  Effects are starting to wane. What little comedown there is almost entirely negligible. Theres about a 20-30 minute period of felling kind of bleh, but within an hour I feel completely normal. No feeling of being drained and no depression. Appetite is returning and I decide to eat a granola bar and a cup of applesauce. I also take 1g of Vit. C, 500mg of ALCAR, 300mg of ALA, and another 200mg of magnesium.
T+3:30  Thanks to the supplements I now feel perfectly fine.
Sleep that night was easy enough. I tossed and turned for maybe 15 minute but I was asleep within 45 minutes of getting into bed. The next morning, I feel completely normal.
IPPH can be summed up in two ways: A perfected version of caffeine would be the first. No jitters, a reasonable length, minimal appetite suppression, and it doesnt feel I wired or tweaked like amphetamine can. The second way would be a more work focused methylphenidate. Because of the lack of euphoria, it isnt very recreational, but it would still be nice at parties just for the social enhancement. Gives a small mood boost which in turn leads to a small confidence boost, so talking to others (I'm naturally anxious) is much easier than normal.
On the whole I find IPPH to take my number 1 spot for a clean, functional stimulant.
Side note on oral dosing: Dosing orally is almost identical except for the (expected) longer duration. If I eat it I usually come up in 30-45 minutes depending on when I last ate, and effects last for around 5-ish hours and then I comedown around T+6:30. Also, this may just be me but I dont notice any loss in potency when eating vs when snorting, but YMMV.
A pick me up with minimal side effects
.
